mail.title: Mail
mail.passwordKept: Stays; type only to change it.
mail.warningUnencrypted: Without encryption the password and the mails cross the network in the clear. Use it only in your own network.
mail.noServer: No mail server set up. Links are shown to copy.
mail.failed: That did not work just now. Try again in a moment.

error.mail_off: No mail server is set up.
error.mail_unreachable: The mail server cannot be reached.
error.mail_tls_failed: The encrypted connection to the mail server failed.
error.mail_auth_refused: The mail server refused the user or password.
error.mail_sender_refused: The mail server refused the sender address.
error.mail_recipient_refused: The mail server refused the recipient address.
error.mail_refused: The mail server refused the mail.
error.mail_failed: The mail did not go out.
error.mail_address_invalid: This is not an email address.
error.unknown: That did not work. Try again.
